providerAccessContext.source: Coordinator message reporting independent read-only AWS STS diagnosis
providerAccessContext.bedrockDiagnosis: Existing AWS SSO token expired; the attempted existing-profile refresh was not completed while awaiting operator browser sign-in. No raw auth log or URL was read by this audit. Provider-error attempts have no model output and no ability score.

gradePolicy: All-pass counts exactly reflect raw episode.score.allPass; finished flags and terminal statuses are separate observations. All recorded grades remain unchanged. Suspected semantic or representation false failures are flagged without regrading. Weighted score and actual optimal current business outcome are separate measurements.
interpretationLimits: Three correlated held-out cases, one attempt per high-effort profile; descriptive diagnostic data, not an independently sampled production distribution or expert-validated insurance benchmark.

Facts, evidence correctness gates and the all-facts-correct current-draft predicate are correlated; weighted losses are not independent domain, provenance and coordination failures. Source IDs attest provenance rather than natural-language proof quality.
Source certificate gaps identify missing relevant operands and are not treated as wrong mathematics; suspected stricter-than-operand grading is flagged without regrading.

No clean tier comparison when any final panel has observed reasoning-inclusive output truncation, provider/budget failure or identity mismatch; no selective rerun or bootstrap. These held-out results do not authorize repairs to this frozen generation.
Do not force a50–60difficulty target or tune after frozen paid results.
